1.

Our Lord, Thee we now praise, Teach us to appreciate more Thy love for the gathering, Which Thou didst dearly purchase here.

2.

Thine beloved for evermore Thou bearest upon Thy heart, And cleansest in the washing of the word On the wilderness path here.

3.

Soon without spot or wrinkle Thou wilt present to Thyself The gathering in snow-white array, Holy and without blame.
